d: Catch all the ground updates from Bay Oval, Tauranga on the eve of the 4th ODI on Aaj Ki Extraaa Khabar! Watch Team India hit the ground in high spirits after a week of rain disruptions, featuring Virat Kohli’s hilarious football banter with Gurnoor Brar and Arshdeep Singh, new vice-captain Ishan Kishan gearing up, intense batting sessions with Rohit Sharma and Shreyas Iyer, and heartwarming fan interactions.
